deploy-bot: Rollout started: service v2.4.1 -> gradual sample 2% (us-west). change window 2025-01-15 18:00-20:00 UTC. Monitoring: latency, 5xx rate. release notes: https://redwood.dev/releases/v2.4.1
jen: quick Q — is this the build with the cache-refactor? any schema changes we should call out?
maria: yes cache-refactor included, feature-flagged. local smoke was green but seeing a small uptick in auth 5xx since 18:04 UTC (~0.12% -> 0.9%).
kiran: can you paste a sample trace id? stack looks like auth.validate_token timing out in a few traces.
maria: tail of logs: `auth-service validate_token timeout=3000ms status=504` x6 in last 2m. attaching short snippet.
sam: perf graphs p50/p95 look fine, but there was a burst of ~50 simultaneous sessions at 18:03 which aligns with the errors.
ops_lead: recommend soft-stop and pin routing for new sessions to v2.4.0 while we investigate. Who will own rollback if needed?
jen: I can coordinate rollback if we decide. vote: :thumbsup: to hold/pin.
kiran: +1 to hold. want to aggregate traces before full rollback.
deploy-bot: ACTION: pausing rollout at 2%. Command run: `/rollout pause 1753139999` — pause acknowledged.
maria: applying routing pin now: `rtg pin us-west v2.4.0` — will route new sessions to v2.4.0, canary instances draining.
deploy-bot: routing pin applied: new sessions -> v2.4.0. Canary nodes will drain.
ops_lead: decision: soft-stop. No immediate full rollback. Timeline: 15m to find root. If auth 5xx > 0.5% at +10m we escalate to full rollback. Assign: @maria investigate auth timeouts, @kiran run trace aggregation.
jen: updating release notes & support blurb: "held for auth timeout spike in us-west". Notifying support channel.
kiran: starting trace aggregation now, will post links (span samples + flamegraphs) in ~2m.
sam: checking rate-limiter/edge infra for correlated errors — nothing obvious so far.
maria: found a header-handling regression in cache-refactor path; preparing a quick revert patch to test in staging.
jen: if patch verifies, proposal: re-run canary at 1% in same window. Who thumbs to re-run after fix? :eyes:
ops_lead: ack. Maintain hold until metrics return to baseline. Update thread when ready to resume. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: NOTE: pause=success, pin=success. Events logged: /deploys/1753139999/events
(ops_lead will revisit decision after trace results / patch verification)
